title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: Track B complete; both approved engine specs are now TRACKED on main (PR #20, merged 11421ef), discharging the spec-loss risk. Standing question answered: NO mitosis spec MSP was ever implemented - PRs #1-#19 are all Track B gate/invariant hardening, and mitosis.js still carries progressPossible, maxSteps and the shepherd stage that M3/M5 delete. Track A stays deferred per 0136. Work now moves to engine implementation: quiescent-advance M0..M8, gated only by one hermeticity check.
spine.next_step: Run the hermeticity check FIRST per 0149: worktree at 11421ef, full suite, compare the pass count against 1761 (the ledger's 1520/1540 is stale). Equal clears the blocker and M0 starts at once - 0085 authorizes it, red test first per spec section 11. Unequal localizes the leak. Re-baseline anchors by execution before trusting any line number (0148). Order after M0: M1 -> M2 -> M6 -> M3 -> M5 -> M4 -> M7 -> M8; 0086 fixes the cap at 8, 0087 fixes class-6 at file level.
open_risks: Spec anchors are pinned to 450804e, an UNMERGED branch head. Against main they run +36 to +78 off, varying BY REGION, so no single offset repairs them. Re-derive by execution before trusting any line number (0148).
M0 is authorized by 0085 but gated by that same decision's caveat: its red-then-green proof needs a trustworthy suite signal. Do not start the red test before the worktree run (0149).

The ledger's 1520/1540 suite figure is STALE. Measured this session: 1761/1761 in the primary working directory, twice. The worktree half of the claim - 2 extra failures at the same commit - was NEVER re-tested.

Hand-written enumerations were wrong on contact in 0137, 0144 and 0145. Specs re-derived by EXECUTION held, including both engine specs at their own baseline (0148). Re-derive; never copy or hand-count.

Section 8's mechanism arithmetic (22 to 14, net -8) was NOT re-verified. It is a hand-written enumeration in a baseline-pinned spec - exactly the class 0137 burned on. Re-derive before it gates an MSP.
NEVER invoke the compiled workflow function. compileWorkflow returns a frozen async callable that would dispatch REAL AGENTS; compileUnderSandbox discards it deliberately. No test may call it.

ALWAYS_DENIED's 54-entry pinned realm surface runs in CI on every push and PR while node-version floats at 26.x, so a Node minor adding a global halts the gate. Fail-closed by design (0140); classify the name, do NOT pin Node.
phase-parity requires any --target to be a compilable workflow body after ^export stripping or it exits 44; a fixture carrying ESM imports would exit 44 unanalyzed.
Track A deferral keeps the 0132 hand-patch window OPEN: the deployed cache carries a guard absent from its recorded SHA 0fe1c02, and a refresh reverts it.
Track A round 3 was never reviewed - probe deletion plus installer.mjs 426 to 135 into four modules, refactor and behaviour in one range. A-1 is a hard gate when Track A resumes.
Six other paused mitosis threads still need per-thread disposition. Each predates 11421ef and must be re-grounded first - this session found PR #14 already merged and main 5 behind.
12 leaked worktrees / ~78MB remain live; the reaper verb does not exist. No worktree was created this session - the hermeticity check will create the first.
PARKED stash@{0} and stash@{1} untouched, depth held at 2. Seven dirty paths remain - stage explicit paths only, NEVER git add -A.
Every write under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} needs per-write human approval; the engine MSPs all edit those trees. Batch edits per file; no unattended fan-out.
The pre-commit hook runs the FULL suite inline (1761 tests, ~187KB in one result). ALWAYS redirect and read only the tail. --no-verify only for a deliberately-red receipt commit.
A PR's scope is FROZEN at creation; post-creation title/body edits are denied. Later facts go in a PR comment (0142). Push once BEFORE opening the PR (0141).
M1 verdict truthfulness stays a HUMAN/orchestrator gate - a subagent cannot cite evidence it never saw (0143). Held again: the orchestrator wrote the coverage entry and ran the gate itself.
The ledger MCP silently DROPS the parameter following a long multi-line value, and update_thread nests spine fields under a spine object with a 500-char cap on each. Order the long field LAST.
task_70509bf0 could NOT be withdrawn - the user must stop it. Its premise is dead.
out_of_scope: Track A / continuity-ledger-plugin until all mitosis MSPs are delivered (0136). A-1, A-2, A-3 and the Track A half of Wave 0 are DEFERRED, not abandoned.
Any further B-6 work. Implemented, merged and green; the invariant is discharged. Re-opening needs a new reason, not a re-read.
Rewriting the specs' 78 anchors as a standalone effort - rejected by 0148. Re-baseline by execution per MSP instead.
Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120.
Cluster-aware scheduling and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - fenced out by spec section 1.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Opening a pull request for docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec - the user ruled on 2026-07-30 that leaving it without a PR is fine.
